//go:build (linux && amd64) || (darwin && arm64)

package gomadio

var gomadNativeRefuseObserver func(string)

func gomadNativeObserveRefuse(operation string) {
	if gomadNativeRefuseObserver != nil {
		gomadNativeRefuseObserver(operation)
	}
}

func GomadNativeRefuseObserverActive() bool {
	return gomadNativeRefuseObserver != nil
}

func GomadNativeInstallRefuseObserver(observer func(string)) (func() bool, bool) {
	if observer == nil || gomadNativeRefuseObserver != nil {
		return nil, false
	}
	gomadNativeRefuseObserver = observer
	restored := false
	return func() bool {
		if restored || gomadNativeRefuseObserver == nil {
			return false
		}
		gomadNativeRefuseObserver = nil
		restored = true
		return true
	}, true
}
